name: hud_ui_composite_panel_scroll_history
description: HudUiCompositePanel::ScrollHistory advances the active entry index, scrolls cached text upward when the ring is full, and invalidates the composite panel.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bbb20 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD composite-panel text source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bbb20 validates activeEntryCount increment, entry-vector count checks, overflow scroll loop, next-entry HudUiPanel::GetLastTextPtr call, current-entry SetText virtual dispatch through slot 35 (+0x8c), activeEntryCount decrement after scrolling, and final Invalidate virtual dispatch through slot 8 (+0x20).

The native composite-panel text-format smoke verifies the real ScrollHistory overflow path through SetTextFmtV: entry text shifts from the next entry to the current entry, activeEntryCount is decremented back to the last entry, and the composite panel is invalidated.
